race.comment: DON'T DOUBT MISSY (1) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Capable of bouncing right back. SHAHAR (8) has hit the top-four at her past six outings and is usually thereabouts. One for the exotics players. SMUDGED (5) resumes here but is yet to miss a drum in two first-up attempts and may run a race while fresh. SNITZSTREAM (3) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated. MAGIC MOZ (4) reasonable effort first up last start, finishing sixth and beaten 4 lengths over 1100m at Ipswich. Fitter now and can get into the placings.
